item.title: Hundreds of haredi protesters gather outside draft evader's home in Modi’in
item.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters gathered overnight outside the home of a draft evader in Modi’in to protest his arrest.
The protesters attempted to break into the draft evader's apartment building. Following clashes between the protesters and police at the scene, the draft evader was released.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition launches Yemen operation against Houthis
item.description: Saudi-led forces launch an operation in Yemen as government troops battle the Iran-backed Houthis, who claim missile and drone attacks on Saudi targets.

item.title: 35-year-old man moderately injured while riding electric scooter in Tel Aviv
item.description:
A 35-year-old man was moderately injured while riding an electric scooter on Dizengoff Street in Tel Aviv.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

item.title: Defense Minister: 2/3 of October 7 terrorists eliminated, we'll get them all
item.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz said that of the 6,000 terrorists who crossed the border into Israel on October 7, 2023, 4,000 have been eliminated so far and 2,000 remain.
According to him, the directive to the IDF and other security forces is to pursue and eliminate them.
Katz added that beyond the goal of dismantling Hamas and demilitarizing the Gaza Strip, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's and his own directive is "to pursue and eliminate everyone without limit and in any situation, from senior to junior."

item.title: From White House to Fox News: Karoline Leavitt's new role
item.description: Former White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt will join Fox News as an on-air contributor, offering political commentary beginning November 1.

item.title: Herzog: Evil Iranian empire must not allowed nuclear capabilities
item.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed the Iranian threat in an interview with Fox News, saying that "Iran is an evil empire that threatens the free world."
Herzog emphasized that "it must not be allowed any access to nuclear capabilities."

item.description: Father of Tom Godo, who was killed by friendly fire in massacre aftermath, interrupts Netanyahu’s memorial address, accusing him of failing October 7 victims.

item.title: 2 arrested after riding motorcycle toward troops in Syria security zone
item.description: A short while ago, IDF soldiers identified two suspects riding a motorcycle towards an IDF post in the Security Zone in southern Syria. Following identification, the soldiers opened a suspect apprehension procedure and apprehended the two suspects. No IDF injuries were reported.

item.title: Military Intelligence Chief: 4,000 October 7 terrorists eliminated
item.description: Military Intelligence Directorate chief Shlomi Binder told the Cabinet that 4,000 of the 6,000 terrorists who participated in the massacre have been eliminated. The hunt for the remainder continues.
